'''Docking bay 4414''' was a [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] that was located in [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]]. In about [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]], the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Darga Jiramma Mionne]] settled on Cloud City and [[Gender/Legends|he]] used docking bay 4414 as his base of operations, keeping his [[Personal Luxury Yacht 3000/Legends|Personal Luxury Yacht 3000]] ''[[Glorious Chariot]]'' and several [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunters]] in the bay. A group of [[Alderaanian Resistance]] agents traveled to Cloud City in search of Darga, and they eventually located him and confronted Darga and the Hutt's forces in docking bay 4414.
